text: これで　こんどこそ　ほんとうに　ほんとうに　ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな　ポケモンずかんを　かんせい　させるのじゃーッ！

structure.jp: ほんとうに　ほんとうに　ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな　ポケモンずかんを
structure.en: a truly, truly tremendous, wonderful and perfect Pokédex

structure.jp: かんせい　させるのじゃーッ！

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.span: かんせい　させるのじゃーッ
patterns.explanation: のだ after a verb can be a strong 'you are to do this'. じゃ is the old-man form of だ, stretched out in a shout. かんせい させるのじゃーッ = 'you must complete it!'

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな
patterns.explanation: Describing words ending in くて or で are strung together to mean 'and', with only the last one in its normal shape. ものすごくて すてきで かんぺきな = 'tremendous, wonderful and perfect'.

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ after a word stresses it: 'this one for sure'. こんどこそ = 'this time for sure'.
